{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
filtered_no_qa = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Now filter for completed orders from loyal customers
filtered_loyal_completed = filtered_no_qa[
    (filtered_no_qa['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (filtered_no_qa['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = filtered_loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the number of completed orders from loyal customers (after removing QA)
print(f'Number of completed orders from loyal customers (excluding QA): {len(filtered_loyal_completed)}')

# Print the mean revenue
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers (excluding QA): {mean_revenue}')"}
